entities.summary: Commissaries general Muhammad Jasin was a National Hero of Indonesia and died on 3 May 2012 in RS Polri Kramat Jati, and he was buried in Taman Makam Pahlawan Kalibata. He is regarded as the founder of the Brimob Polri, which he formed from the existing Japanese-controlled Special Police Corps. For his actions against the Japanese occupiers and later participation in the Indonesian National Revolution, he received a National Hero of Indonesia title, along with Bernard Wilhelm Lapian, Mas Isman, I Gusti Ngurah Made Agung and Ki Bagus Hadikusumo, by President Joko Widodo on 5 November 2015.
